HeartGold & SoulSilver series · UL

HS—Unleashed

Released May 12, 2010 · 96 cards

HS—Unleashed is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the HeartGold & SoulSilver series, released in English on May 12, 2010. Its main set has 95 cards, plus 1 secret rare numbered beyond the set (96 in total). It includes 82 Pokémon, 14 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

22 illustrators worked on HS—Unleashed. Most cards: Kouki Saitou (14), Wataru Kawahara (11), Hideaki Hakozaki (9), Masakazu Fukuda (8), match (6), Hajime Kusajima (5), Takashi Yamaguchi (5), Ken Sugimori (4).
